public voidRdKafka\KafkaConsumer::close
Close down the KafkaConsumer. This call will block until the consumer has revoked its assignment, calling the rebalance_cb if it is configured, committed offsets to broker, and left the consumer group. The maximum blocking time is roughly limited to session.timeout.ms.
If RdKafka\KafkaConsumer::closeAsync was called first, RdKafka\KafkaConsumer::close waits for that close to finish instead of starting another one, then releases the consumer.
If the rebalance callback throws, or returns without acknowledging the revocation, the consumer releases the partitions itself so that closing can finish. The callback's exception is thrown once the consumer is closed.
Once this method starts closing the consumer, the consumer is closed and released when the method returns or throws, and topics and queues obtained from the consumer are invalidated. The method throws without closing anything when it is called from one of the consumer's callbacks, or while another call to RdKafka\KafkaConsumer::close is still running, for example from an error handler.
